messages.subject: addResourcePath no longer working properly
parts:
After the update to 0.10.x It seems that putting addResourcePath calls in .onAttach for packages adding functionality to shiny, no longer works properly. When calling runApp the server script doesn't load before the index.html file is opened resulting in problems with loading additional resources as addResourcePath hasn't been called yet. When refreshing the page the problem disappears further indicating that the problem is about timing in the runApp code. Maybe this is only a problem when using custom html pages instead of ui.R?

best

Thomas

messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: Re: addResourcePath no longer working properly
parts:
I just pocked around in the runApp function, and it seems that even though the documentation states it (under the description of the launch.browser parameter) there is no check whether the server had started before launching the browser. This means that servers that needs to load a lot of packages etc will not have finished starting before the browser starts, leading to the problems described in the beginning. I suspect the reason why it happens for apps with their own index.html file rather than ui.R is that the time it takes for shiny to create the html based on ui.R is enough to get the server started.

Anyway. Adding Sys.sleep(1) before the call to launch.browser or utiles::browseURL solves the problem, but better would be to check the server directly and not launch the browser until it has finished setting itself up.

best
Thomas
